% ---------- Statutory rules relevant to the claim ----------
% Basic standard deduction for heads of household
% 2018-2025 special rule
basic_standard_deduction(Year, Person, 18000) :-
    head_of_household(Year, Person),
    Year >= 2018,
    Year =< 2025.

% Otherwise (pre-2018 or post-2025)
basic_standard_deduction(Year, Person, 4400) :-
    head_of_household(Year, Person),
    (Year < 2018 ; Year > 2025).

% ---------- Facts from the case ----------
person(alice).
head_of_household(2017, alice).
paid_wages(2017, alice, 33200).

% ---------- Verification goal ----------
:- (  basic_standard_deduction(2017, alice, 4400)
   -> format('Result: Entailment~n')
   ;  format('Result: Contradiction~n')
   ).
:- halt.

expected.question: Under section 63(c)(2)(B), Alice's basic standard deduction in 2017 is equal to $4400.
